author: Kadir0
quote: I genuinely wonder how you managed to waste a game with this much potential. The graphics are great and the map is amazing, yet such massive potential has been ruined just to cater to extreme realism and woke/feminist agendas. As someone who has been playing GTA games since I was 6 years old, this simply does not feel like a GTA game. I play GTA to do the things I can't do in real life. The whole point of this franchise is chaos and total freedom, yet I'm stuck carrying a ridiculously limited amount of weapons. I want to carry an entire army's worth of weapons on me—because this is GTA! There are so many things like this that completely go against the true spirit of the series.
